verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a cloud file-storage product, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a region or data-residency control for Google Drive. Community mentions of using rclone to copy Drive data to S3 or local storage are user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
